body.x: LG Electronics (LG) is showcasing its large capacity refrigerators with the unique Door-in-Door system at the 2013 Consumer Electronics Show (CES). A proprietary LG design, the ultra-convenient double layered Door-in-Door system opens with the simple push of a button, giving consumers quick access to their favorite snacks and drinks. In addition to putting sought-after items within easy reach, this sealed Door-in-Door compartment prevents the refrigerator’s chilled air from escaping, helping to keep food fresher longer.

“LG’s latest user-friendly refrigerators now provide more usable storage space and a number of new convenience-oriented features,” said Seong-jin Jo, President and CEO of the LG Electronics Home Appliance Company. “LG has specifically focused on advanced insulation technologies, and this expertise enabled the larger capacities. The Door-in-Door, double layered door system and new organization systems are clear illustrations of LG’s commitment to bringing truly smart product designs to the consumer.”
